| `Infrastructure/AppHostFixture.cs` | Boots the Aspire AppHost via `DistributedApplicationTestingBuilder`, waits for the OpenAI resource to be healthy |
| `Infrastructure/EvaluationBase.cs` | Base class wiring up `IChatClient` from the host, provides `GetDefaultEvaluators()` (Coherence, Relevance, Fluency, Groundedness) and an `EvaluateAsync` helper |
| `ChatEvaluationTests.cs` | Three sample evaluation tests — coherent response, follow-up handling, and harmful-content refusal |

**Packages used:**
- `Aspire.Hosting.Testing` 13.4.6
- `Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation` 10.7.0
- `Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation.Quality` 10.7.0
- `Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation.Reporting` 10.7.0

Run with `dotnet test MyApp.Evaluation/` (requires Azure OpenAI credentials configured for the `openai` resource).
